title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Training of Judicial Police of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Circular on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Training of Judicial Police of People's Courts

Fa [1999] No. 58

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Interim Measures for the Training of Judicial Police of People's Courts are hereby issued for your implementation in light of the actual circumstances of your region.

April 19, 1999

Interim Measures for the Training of Judicial Police of People's Courts

Chapter I General Provisions

Article 1 These Measures are formulated in accordance with the People's Police Law of the People's Republic of China, the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Police Ranks of the People's Police, and the Interim Regulations of the People's Courts on Judicial Police, for the purpose of establishing and improving the training system for judicial police of people's courts.

Article 2 The training of judicial police of people's courts shall be guided by Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and Deng Xiaoping Theory, adhere to the principles of integrating theory with practice, combining learning with application, providing training according to needs, and emphasizing practical results, consistently incorporate education on the proletarian world outlook, outlook on life, and integrity and devotion to public service, and strive to improve the overall quality and combat effectiveness of the contingent.

Article 3 Judicial police of people's courts must receive training in accordance with these Measures. The results and evaluations of training shall be filed in their personal archives and serve as the basis for taking up posts, conferring ranks, promoting in police rank, and performing duties. Those who fail the training shall not be allowed to take up posts, nor shall they be conferred or promoted in police rank.

Article 4 During the period of participating in and receiving training, judicial police of people's courts shall have their salaries and welfare benefits remain unchanged.

Chapter II Types of Training

Article 5 The training of judicial police of people's courts is divided into initial training for newly recruited judicial police, training for police rank promotion and for newly appointed leadership positions of judicial police, specialized professional and on-the-job training, and knowledge and skills updating training. According to the positions and police ranks of judicial police, training is classified as advanced training, intermediate training, and basic training.

Article 6 Advanced training includes: training for Police Supervisors selected for promotion to Police Commissioner, training for persons newly appointed to leadership positions in General Teams, and specialized professional, knowledge and skills updating, and on-the-job training for personnel holding the rank of Police Commissioner.

Article 7 Intermediate training includes: training for Police Superintendents promoted to Police Supervisor, training for persons newly appointed to leadership positions in Detachments (Brigades), and specialized professional, knowledge and skills updating, and on-the-job training for personnel holding the rank of Police Supervisor.

Article 8 Basic training includes: initial training for newly recruited judicial police, and specialized professional, knowledge and skills updating, and on-the-job training for personnel below the rank of First Class Police Superintendent.

For judicial police of people's courts who have graduated from training entrusted to relevant colleges and institutions, the subjects, content, and duration of initial training shall be arranged by the Judicial Police General Team.

Article 9 Training for police rank promotion and for newly appointed leadership positions of judicial police may be conducted jointly as needed.

Chapter III Training Content and Duration

Article 10 The main content of initial training for newly recruited judicial police is: basic knowledge of political theory, basic knowledge of law, basic knowledge of judicial police professional work, and physical and tactical training. The duration of training shall be no less than two months.

Article 11 The main content of training for police rank promotion and for newly appointed positions of judicial police is: political theory, laws and regulations, administrative management, leadership science, research on judicial police work, and physical and tactical training. The duration of training shall be no less than one month.

Article 12 The content of specialized professional and on-the-job training shall be determined according to actual work needs. The duration of training shall be no less than 15 days.

Article 13 The content and duration of knowledge and skills updating training shall be determined according to the needs of the situation and tasks.

Article 14 Training shall use the "Judicial Police Training Course" uniformly compiled by the Judicial Police Bureau of the Supreme People's Court, and the textbooks selected by the Judicial Police General Teams of the High People's Courts, as well as designated relevant teaching materials.

Chapter IV Training Management

Article 15 The training of judicial police of people's courts shall be managed at different levels. Advanced, intermediate, and basic training shall be organized and managed by the Supreme People's Court, the High People's Courts, and the Intermediate People's Courts, respectively.

Article 16 The Supreme People's Court shall guide, coordinate, and manage the training of judicial police of courts nationwide; formulate the overall training plan, training teaching plan, training teaching syllabus, and assessment and acceptance plan; and organize the compilation of training courses and teaching materials.

Article 17 High People's Courts shall guide, coordinate, and manage the training of judicial police within their respective provinces (municipalities, autonomous regions). They shall formulate training implementation plans based on the overall training plan formulated by the Supreme People's Court, in light of the actual circumstances of their region, and organize and carry out training work.

Article 18 Intermediate People's Courts shall guide, coordinate, and manage the training of judicial police within their respective regions. They shall formulate training plans based on the training plans formulated by the Supreme People's Court and the High People's Courts, and organize and carry out training work.

Article 19 The Supreme People's Court and the High People's Courts shall respectively organize evaluations of judicial police training work, and grant rewards based on the evaluation results.

Article 20 Training funds for judicial police shall be included in the scope of operational funds of courts at all levels and used exclusively for that purpose.

Chapter V Training Tasks

Article 21 The Supreme People's Court shall be responsible for and guide the advanced training and other training of judicial police of courts nationwide.

Article 22 High People's Courts shall be responsible for the intermediate training and other training of judicial police within their respective provinces (municipalities, autonomous regions).

Article 23 Intermediate People's Courts shall be responsible for the basic training and other training of judicial police within their respective regions.

Article 24 The training of judicial police must be organized and implemented in accordance with the "Judicial Police Training Outline." Upon completion of training, a comprehensive assessment shall be conducted, and certificates shall be issued to those who pass.

Chapter VI Supplementary Provisions

Article 25 These Measures shall be interpreted by the Supreme People's Court.

Article 26 These Measures shall come into force as of the date of issuance.
